sources: Microsoft Learn: 'SystemParametersInfoW function', SPI_SETMOUSE (two thresholds and acceleration). Values 0, 0, 0 match 'Enhance pointer precision' off. The app sets the values through this function (takes effect immediately) and restores all three original values when resetting.
The description only promises even pointer movement, not an FPS effect.
measuredOn: Microsoft Learn: SystemParametersInfo SPI_SETMOUSE (acceleration thresholds and factor 0 = pointer follows the mouse without acceleration); host test 26200: values checked before and after
